info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Treasury Analysis API
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Analysis API provides financial insights and analytics specifically tailored for corporate treasury management. It enables businesses to access and analyze their treasury activities, cash flow positions, and risk assessments. This API is typically utilized by financial analysts, treasury managers, and corporate finance teams to make informed decisions regarding cash management and funding strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their financial planning and optimize liquidity management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the corporate treasury analysis data, providing insights and analyses of treasury operations within corporations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a corporate treasury analysis operation. The payload should comply with the specified schema to ensure that all required parameters for the analysis are provided correctly.

200.description: The request was successful, and the analysis data is returned.
